title: No test covers the 404 not-found path for GET/PUT/DELETE /books/{id}
evidence: main_test.go only exercises existing IDs; main.go:185-187,200-202,211-213 return 404 on sql.ErrNoRows but no test asserts it
suggestion: Add a test requesting a missing ID and assert 404

title: No test for malformed-JSON / method-not-allowed responses
evidence: decodeInput returns 400 on bad JSON (main.go:228-230) and methodNotAllowed returns 405 (main.go:248-251); neither is asserted in main_test.go
suggestion: Add tests for invalid JSON body (400) and an unsupported method (405)

title: Pure-Go modernc.org/sqlite avoids cgo
evidence: go.mod requires modernc.org/sqlite v1.29.6 (no cgo), so the build is portable
suggestion: None — noted as a good stack choice
